title: NCCL README and makefiles/version.mk (master)
notes: Fetched live via GitHub raw 2026-11-05: NCCL implements all-reduce, all-gather, reduce, broadcast, reduce-scatter and send/receive patterns; optimized for PCIe, NVLink, NVSwitch, InfiniBand Verbs and TCP/IP sockets; usable in single- or multi-process (MPI) apps; version.mk reads 2.32.3; copyright notice 2015-2020; current source files carry SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0.

title: NCCL source: default tuner constants (src/tuning/cost_model.cc) and algorithm list (src/include/device.h)
notes: Fetched live via GitHub raw 2026-11-05. Base latencies (us): Ring LL 6.6 / Simple 8.4; Tree LL 6.8 / Simple 8.4. Per-hop hardware latency: NVLink Ring LL 0.6 / Simple 3.4, NVLS 25; network Ring LL 2.7 / Simple 14, Tree LL 5.0 / Simple 14, NVLS 18. Algorithms: Tree, Ring, CollNet Direct, CollNet Chain, NVLS, NVLS Tree, PAT.
